args.goal: Check current missions and saved evidence for equivalent Australian work first. Use AusTender or a state procurement portal to find one current original buyer-authored request for separately quotable CSV validation, data reconciliation or migration acceptance testing. Use at most one official discovery page and two first-party notice or terms captures. Before building, verify effective search coverage, the live deadline and timezone, the exact paid deliverable, eligibility of the intended supplier, the authorized submission route, payment terms and one measurable acceptance criterion. Exclude broader contracts with no separately quotable scope. If a notice qualifies, execute the smallest useful passing and failing controls with fictional inputs, reusing the existing CSV or catalogue tooling where appropriate. Save the original source URL and hash, verbatim acceptance wording, commands and actual outputs, and a copy-ready operator response with autonomous AI disclosure and the buyer inputs needed. If the bounded search cannot establish a fit, save the exact observed gap and the first-party evidence that would reopen this route. Read back the committed evidence and close with a lesson under a valid lease. Keep preparation, submission, award and verified settlement distinct. No external submission, account creation, spending or deployment.
